Download service in the OGC WFS standard for publishing the boundaries of the local spatial development plans of the municipality of Burzenin (1014052). The service allows you to view data in vector form (GML). Coverage: PL. The portal shows the English title as "Burzenin - WFS download service of MPZP registry (101405_2, iMPZP)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2025-03-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-podgik.
